title: Grateful Dead Live at CBS Studios in West Hollywood on 1969-01-18
lineage: audio processed in Soundforge 6.0, 48kHz, 1536kbps wav, mono) extracted to 44.1kHz, 1411kbps wav with DVD Audio Extractor> tracks cut with GoldWave> compressed to flac with EasyFlac level 5. No SBE's verified with shntool.

ai_review.summary: TV‑recorded Playboy After Dark set captures a groovin' 'Mountains on the Moon' and a kick‑ass St. Stephen, with decent TV mix and the historic two‑drummer moment.
ai_review.review: The recording is a television broadcast from the 1969 Playboy After Dark show, offering clear enough sound for enjoyment despite not being a pure soundboard source. The performance shines on 'Mountains on the Moon' and a tight, energetic St. Stephen, plus a memorable interview with Hugh Hefner and the novelty of two drummers on stage.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4‑5 stars, praising both the music and the acceptable TV audio; only one low rating comments on broadcast delay, so overall impression is strongly positive.

recording_quality.technical_notes: TV broadcast sound described as 'fine' and 'decent'; no major drop‑outs noted, but not a high‑fidelity soundboard mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Brief set interspersed with interview segments; maintains a laid‑back yet lively vibe throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Impromptu 'buck knives' story shows his quick wit and engaging stage presence.
band_member_comments.Keys: Tom Constanten on keys noted as part of the historic moment.
band_member_comments.Drums: Two‑drummer configuration (Bill Kreutzmann & Mickey Hart) highlighted as a unique, memorable element.
